messages.content: Who won the chess tournament in 2015?

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

message.content:
The most prominent chess event of 2015 was the **World Chess Championship**.  
In that match, held in New York City from September 24 to October 1, 2015, **Magnus Carlsen** defended his title against Sergey Karjakin and emerged victorious with a score of 6½–4½.  

If you were referring to a different tournament (e.g., the Chess Olympiad, the Candidates Tournament, or a specific national championship), let me know and I can give you the winner for that event instead!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which chess tournament? Could refer to World Chess Championship 2015? That was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin. Carlsen won. Or could refer to some other tournament like the Chess Olympiad 2015? That was won by Russia. But likely they mean the World Chess Championship 2015. So answer: Magnus Carlsen. Provide context.
